column2: A realistic full-body 3D game character of an ancient Chinese Han dynasty imperial palace guard soldier, standing upright in a strict T-pose with both arms stretched straight out sideways at shoulder height, palms facing down, feet shoulder-width apart, empty open hands, holding nothing. He wears dark lacquered iron lamellar armour laced with crimson cord over a deep red robe, layered lamellar shoulder guards, a polished iron helmet with a tall crest of black and red pheasant feathers and cheek guards, a wide leather belt with a bronze buckle, an armoured lamellar skirt to the knees, wrapped leggings and black leather boots, a short crimson cape. Adult man around thirty, stern bearded face with realistic detailed features. Photorealistic PBR materials, worn metal, fabric and leather textures, facing forward.

A realistic full-body 3D game character of a lean agile ancient Chinese Han dynasty elite light infantry swordsman, standing upright in a strict T-pose with both arms stretched straight out sideways at shoulder height, palms facing down, feet shoulder-width apart, empty open hands, holding nothing. Photorealistic PBR materials, worn metal, fabric and leather textures, realistic detailed face, facing forward. He wears a dark brown leather lamellar vest over an ochre robe with black tiger-stripe patterned trims, a black cloth headscarf tied over a topknot with a tiger-stripe headband, leather bracers, a cloth sash with a hanging jade pendant, fitted trousers wrapped at the shins, light black boots. Young man in his twenties, sharp alert face, thin moustache.

Broad-shouldered powerful man around forty, scarred fierce face.

A realistic full-body 3D model of an ancient Chinese Han dynasty armoured war horse, standing on all four legs in a neutral side pose, head forward, wearing dark iron lamellar horse barding laced with red cord that covers the neck, chest and flanks, an iron chanfron on the face, a red plume on top of the head, a padded leather saddle with high front and back arches, saddle cloth, bridle and reins, no stirrups, no rider. Strong muscular bay horse, realistic proportions, photorealistic PBR materials.
